Remark
[estimates for scalar curvature] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Remark 13.13\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals The proof only requires $r_k^{-n}\vol (B(p_k,r_k))\to 0$, an upper bound for $r_k^2R$, and a uniform upper bound for $\vol (B(p_k,r_k))/\vol (B(p_k,r_k/2))$. If the last ratio is at least $3^n$, replace $r_k$ by $r_k/2$ and iterate; the normalized volume and scalar bound persist.
